PARA.TITLE: Non-standard Size AM/FM Electronic Tuner with Integrated CD Player

ITEM.PTXT: An irregular-size CD player integrated AM/FM electronic tuner has been adopted and combined with the 6 speaker system.
Tone control memory has been adopted. Tone control (bass and treble) values can be stored for each mode (CD, AM, FM, etc.).
By adopting a CD text display function, information pre-entered on the CD being played (artist name, track name, etc.) can be displayed.
CDs recorded in WMA (Windows Media Audio) and MP3 (MPEG Audio Layer 3) formats can be played, improving marketability.
An automatic sound levelizer function has been adopted, providing excellent usability.
Noise has been reduced by digital signal processing of AM/FM reception.
Depending on the device used for recording, some CD-Rs and CD-RWs may not play.

SPEC.TITLE: Irregular-size CD Player Integrated AM/FM Electronic Tuner Functions

ENTRY.PTXT: PLL synthesizer tuning. Manual preset: up to 6 stations each for AM/FM. Auto preset: up to 6 stations each for AM/FM. Automatic reception sensitivity switching (AM). Traffic information reception. Digital signal processing.
FAST UP/DOWN。 TRACK UP/DOWN。 TRACK RANDOM。 TRACK RPT。 CD text display function.
FAST UP/DOWN。 FOLDER UP/DOWN。 FILE UP/DOWN。 RANDOM within DISC. RANDOM within FOLDER. FOLDER RPT。 FILE RPT。 Folder list display. File list display.

Tone control (bass and treble). Tone control memory. Volume balance control (front/rear and left/right). Direct source change. Built-in FIX equalizer. Automatic sound levelizer function. LIVE-ACS function. Maximum total output 160W (40W x 4).
